reports.headline: One qualifier: Liftoff Mobile (LFTO) beat and raised with 32% growth; Accelevation (ACCV) a near-miss on margins.
reports.summary: Liftoff Mobile grew revenue 32%, swung to a large GAAP profit, beat its own guide and lifted its full-year outlook, sending shares up about 15% after hours from near their lows. Accelevation grew 66% with strong cash flow but margins and GAAP profit fell. Nu, dLocal and StoneCo failed on misses or weak guidance; macro is dominated by Nvidia's CEO exit and Fed hike pricing.
reports.html:
Finalists

LFTO Liftoff Mobile — closed $18.71 Thu; after hours $21.52 +15% (verified pre-market quote not found; now slightly above the $20 line)

  • Q3 revenue $237.5M, +32% YoY (core advertising +33%); beat the top of its own guide by ~$16M.
  • GAAP net income $86.7M, diluted EPS $0.47 vs a loss a year ago; adj. EBITDA $144.9M (+45%), 61% margin (56% a year ago).
  • Guidance up: Q4 revenue $244–249M; FY26 revenue $907–912M vs ~$879M FactSet consensus; FY adj. EBITDA $547–551M.
  • Cash flow: TTM FCF $249M (+158%); cash $385.7M.
  • Setup: stock was near the low end of its $13.96–$30.10 52-week range before the print.

Red flags: ~$1.4B debt (net leverage 2.1x, down from 2.4x); Q3 GAAP profit helped by a $14.4M contingent-consideration gain; share count up ~38% this year from the IPO; organic vs acquired growth not split out.

Near-misses

ACCV Accelevation Holdings — $12.21 close Thu (first report since its Sept IPO)

  • Revenue $202.2M, +65.9% YoY; bookings growth over 350%; FY26 guide revenue $905–915M, adj. EBITDA $155–165M.
  • Strong cash: Q3 operating cash flow $62.5M, FCF $55.0M.

Why not a finalist: GAAP net income fell 77% to $3.2M; adj. EBITDA margin fell to 18.7% from 23.7%; interest expense nearly tripled; $655M debt at quarter end (partly repaid with IPO cash); acquisition contribution not disclosed; no prior guidance to judge a raise; pre-market reaction not verified.

Reported but failed the screen

TickerWhy it failed
NU~$12.20 pre-market (+3%); record profit but missed on revenue ($5.82B vs $5.91B) and adj. EPS ($0.22 vs $0.23).
DLORevenue +41% but missed ($398.0M vs $409.2M est.); outlook only reaffirmed; reaction not verified.
STNERevenue +3%; cut 2026 EPS outlook and withdrew 2027 targets.
FluentUp ~20% pre-market, but revenue growth only +14% and still loss-making.
NewsmaxUp ~15% pre-market; profit leaned on a $14M one-time payment.
CBRSRaised guide, Microsoft deal, up 11–17% pre-market; but GAAP revenue missed, deep losses, not a cheap stock.
VTSI, WYYStrong revenue beats (+42%, +27%) but micro-caps likely below the size/options-liquidity bar; market caps not verified.
KSCPRevenue up ~177% but going-concern warning.

Bigger movers and macro

Cisco: revenue +24% and raised FY guide, yet down 2–3% pre-market on gross-margin slippage (65.6% vs 68.1%). Applied Materials: revenue +53% beat. Modine +31–38% on a report that Samsung is in talks to buy it. Nvidia rebounding ~2% after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO Thursday (CFO Colette Kress interim). October PPI +0.3% m/m (vs +0.4% est.), +6.5% y/y; markets are pricing a December Fed hike; the 10-year is back above 5%. Microsoft down ~1.4% on a global Microsoft 365 outage. Russell 2000 weak early.

Option quotes before 9:30am ET are stale; implied volatility typically drops after earnings.

reports.headline: AEVEX (AVEX) is the lone finalist: revenue +56% with a big guidance raise from a beaten-down price; Intuitive Machines was a near-miss on acquisition-driven growth.
reports.summary: AEVEX grew Q3 revenue 56.5% (mostly organic), lifted adj. EBITDA 73% and raised FY26 revenue guidance to $820–840M, with shares near the bottom of a $8.95–$42.34 range. Intuitive Machines beat and turned free cash flow positive but its growth is acquisition-driven; Ondas and Paysafe failed. Nvidia sank after hours on a report the board may remove Jensen Huang.
reports.html:
Finalists

AVEX AEVEX Corp — Q3 2026 (reported after the close Nov 11) · after hours ~+10% to +11% (pre-market price not verified; last verified close $11.56 on Nov 9)
MetricQ3 2026Q3 2025
Revenue$189.7M (+56.5% YoY)$121.2M
Airborne Systems$147.8M (+67.1%)—
Global Solutions$27.5M (−10.7%)—
Maritime (acquired BlackSea, Sept 8)$12.4M—
Adj. EBITDA / margin$30.8M / 16.2%$17.8M / 14.6%
Per-share result$(0.40) loss (GAAP vs adjusted not specified in source)—

Guidance: FY26 revenue raised to $820–840M (from $700–720M; midpoint above ~$755M consensus); adj. EBITDA raised to $128–132M (from $105–111.5M).

Why it qualifies: growth is mostly organic (ex-Maritime acquisition, revenue still up ~46%), EBITDA up 73% with margin expansion, and a large guidance raise. Stock was beaten down beforehand: 52-week range $8.95–$42.34, ~$11.56 on Nov 9.

Red flags: still loss-making per share; cash, debt and cash flow not verified (release page failed to load); Global Solutions shrinking and Ukraine-related revenue fading; recent IPO with a volatile chart; EPS consensus not verified.

Near-misses

LUNR Intuitive Machines — Q3 2026 (pre-market Nov 12) · pre-market ~+11% (prior close $12.18)

Revenue $269.3M (+414% YoY) vs ~$246M consensus; EPS $(0.02) vs $(0.10) expected; adj. EBITDA +$8.3M vs $(13.2)M; Q3 free cash flow +$33M; record backlog $1.9B. FY26 revenue guide $920–950M (earlier guidance cited as $900M–$1B, so the range narrowed rather than clearly rising).

Why not a finalist: growth is driven mainly by the Lanteris acquisition (organic split not disclosed); ~$337M long-term debt; ~$512M of equity raised YTD (dilution); 9-month FCF still −$112M; one-off legal ($10.3M) and deal costs in EBITDA.

Failed the screen

ONDS Ondas — revenue $167.5M (16x YoY, 64% pro forma organic) beat ~$148M; FY26 guide raised to ≥$550M. Failed: adj. EBITDA −$59.7M, GAAP gross margin fell to 21.8% from 43.1%, shares outstanding +55% this year. Pre-market ~−4% (~$5.73 reference).
PSFE Paysafe — missed EPS by $0.11 and revenue estimates, weak guidance; stock ~−30%.

Other reports in the window were outside the price filter or mixed: Corteva (CTVA) −8% AH on revenue miss and outlook cut; Tetra Tech (TTEK) +8% AH, backlog $4.67B; Digi International (DGII) −15% AH despite record revenue; Nebius (NBIS), Brookfield (BN) and Siemens also reported pre-market.

Market backdrop

Nvidia fell ~8.6% after hours on a WSJ report that its board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang (no company response); Nasdaq futures were down ~0.8%. AMD and Broadcom were higher pre-market. Wednesday closed strong (S&P +1.3%, Nasdaq +1.6%; CoreWeave +25% on its beat). Markets price ~90% odds of a December Fed hike after the hot October CPI. Cisco, Applied Materials and Cerebras report after today's close.

Pre-market data was thin today: several recap pages (Benzinga, Chartmill, CNBC) failed to load, and verified pre-market prices for AVEX and LUNR were not available.

Option quotes before 9:30am ET are stale; implied volatility typically drops after earnings.

reports.headline: Riskified (RSKD) is the lone finalist: revenue growth accelerated to 41% with a third guidance raise; Gevo and Satellogic were near-misses.
reports.summary: Riskified posted Q3 revenue of $115.2M (+41% YoY, organic), record free cash flow, zero debt, and raised FY26 revenue guidance to $427–433M; shares were up roughly 20–25% pre-market. Gevo (+94% revenue, big EBITDA beat) and Satellogic (+342% revenue, first positive adj. EBITDA) missed the cut on non-recurring revenue, debt, cash burn and dilution. Futures rose after Tuesday's CPI-driven selloff.

Guidance: FY26 revenue raised to $427–433M (from $400–410M); adj. EBITDA to $39–43M (from $33–39M) — third raise this year.

Why it qualifies: organic growth accelerated to 41% (new merchants, Digital Finance billings +300%), near GAAP breakeven, ~$235M cash/deposits/investments, zero debt, share count down ~10% YTD on ~$94M of buybacks.

Red flags: gross margin fell 7 pts (lower-margin new verticals); EBITDA margin flat at 7%; growth concentrated in a few newly onboarded Digital Finance merchants; consensus figures not verified; big gap-up means much of the news may be priced in.

Near-misses

GEVO Gevo — ~$1.67 pre-market ~+20% (prior close ~$1.39–1.41). Revenue $83.0M (+94%) vs ~$56M consensus; GAAP EPS $0.09 vs $0.02 est.; adj. EBITDA $44M vs $7M; FY26 adj. EBITDA guide >$90M. Missed the cut: ~$20M of revenue is non-recurring banked CFR credit sales, loans payable rose to $168M vs $68M cash, 9-month FCF still negative (~$-40M), $136M YTD impairments, and sub-$2 share price (~$352M cap).
SATL Satellogic — $4.71 pre-market +20.8% (close $3.90). Revenue $16.0M (+342%) vs ~$12.4M est.; adj. EBITDA +$1.2M vs $(4.9)M. Missed the cut: lumpy Space Systems sale drove most growth, GAAP profit came from a $30M non-cash fair-value gain, Q3 operating cash burn $10.4M, Class A shares +15% YTD, RPO fell to $66.9M from $80.7M.

reports.headline: Two qualifiers: Quantum (QMCO) +43% revenue and no debt; Venture Global (VG) +43% with raised EBITDA guide
reports.summary: Quantum beat estimates with revenue up 43% and adj. EBITDA up sharply, and has cleared its debt; the main caveat is a warrant-driven GAAP loss. Venture Global grew revenue 43% and raised its full-year EBITDA guide but carries ~$44.6B of debt. Digital Turbine grew 27% and raised its revenue guide but is down ~25% pre-market on margins, while October CPI came in hotter than expected.
reports.html:
Finalists

QMCO Quantum Corp · pre-market ~$19.6–19.8 +15–16%

FQ2 2027 (Sep qtr): revenue $89.6M, +42.9% YoY (est. $82.2M, beat). Non-GAAP EPS $0.25 vs $0.12 est. Gross margin 41.0% (+340 bp). Adj. EBITDA $11.1M vs $0.5M a year ago. No debt (term loan and $90M convert cleared since March); cash $67.5M; record backlog ~$100M.

Guidance: FQ3 revenue $91M ±$2M, adj. EPS $0.20 ±$0.10, adj. EBITDA $9.1M.

Red flags: GAAP net loss $44.8M ($-1.14/sh) from a $51.6M non-cash warrant fair-value charge, so warrants are a dilution overhang. The stock is not beaten down: it rallied hard after the August report and is now at the top of the price range. Option liquidity not checked.

VG Venture Global · pre-market ~$12.44 +5%

Q3 2026: revenue $4.76B, +43% YoY. Diluted EPS $0.96 vs $0.16. Consolidated adj. EBITDA $2.58B (+69%).

Guidance: FY26 adj. EBITDA raised to $10.0–10.3B (from $8.7–9.1B); cargo range 509–518.

Red flags: very heavy debt, about $44.6B total (up from ~$34.2B at year-end) to fund build-out. Earnings depend on LNG prices and fees. Analyst EPS estimate not verified.

Near-miss

APPS Digital Turbine · ~-25% pre-market

Revenue $178.7M, +27% (beat $166.7M); GAAP EPS $0.06 (vs $-0.20 loss); adj. EPS $0.18 vs $0.16; adj. EBITDA +46%. FY27 revenue raised to $670–690M, but EBITDA guide held at $145–155M. Shares fell on disappointing margins. Also: ~$344M long-term debt, and a prior-quarter revision for understated revenue-share expense. Pre-market price not verified.
